audit.why: 52.32% over 1252 games. Lane difficulty is a range fight Aurora wins: Q reaches 900 against Transfusion's 600 and Tides of Blood's 600, and Vladimir pays his own health to cast E. The difficulty is entirely his escape — Sanguine Pool is 2 untargetable seconds on 28/25/22/19/16.
audit.corrected: Difficulty 5.5/10 retained; framed around range and the pool timer rather than 'his engage'.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spikes and late-game text treat this as pure burst-versus-sustain and never name Grievous Wounds as the timing that decides it, even though the itemization line already assumes it.
audit.why: Crimson Pact converts AP into health and health into AP, so Vladimir spikes on every AP item twice over. Transfusion is free to cast and drops to 4.6s at rank 5; Hemoplague heals him for each champion it hits. Anti-heal timing, not raw burst, is the late-game spike that matters.
audit.corrected: late, whys[6], breakdown.late and breakdown.carry now hang on anti-heal and on Crimson Pact's double scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text claims 'Between Worlds' untargetability lets you dodge the initial cast window'. Aurora's R grants no untargetability — Riot's text is a leap, a shockwave that damages and slows, and a zone she can teleport across. The invisibility hop is Across the Veil (W).
audit.why: Fabricated defensive property on the owner's ultimate. The real Hemoplague answer is its delay: it marks a 625-range area and only detonates after a few seconds, so the W hop and its move speed take you out of the zone before the damage and his heal land. Also unstated anywhere: Tides of Blood is blocked by enemy units, so standing behind your own wave denies his 13s charge outright.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, whys[4] and mid rewritten around the detonation delay and the W hop; minion-block added to dosFull[2].d and report[5].t.

audit.why: Defect item 3. Sanguine Pool 28s at rank 1 for 2 seconds untargetable, Transfusion 9s down to 4.6s, Tides of Blood 13s down to 5s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cross-layer level chart disagreement on four rows: phases[3].side and phases[4].side read 'Skill' and phases[5].side and phases[6].side read 'Vladimir', while win[3..6] all read 'Aurora' and the packet levelChart reads Aurora on all seven rows.
audit.why: The packet, the content layer and every phases[N].why (all four describe Aurora spiking — Lost Chapter, Between Worlds, Luden's, late zone control) agree on Aurora; only the side token dissented, so the side token was the stale layer. Flipped as one atomic group; the whys already state the Aurora verdict, so no why contradicts its row after the change.
audit.corrected: phases[3..6].side set to Aurora, phases[3].rating raised to 6/10 to match the neighbouring Aurora rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed in dosFull[1].d (tradeGood verbatim), dontsFull[1].d (the dontsFull[0] body) and dontsFull[2].d (tradeBad verbatim); dosFull[0].d carried the cooldowns sentence.
audit.why: Defect item 2 — title and body describe different things.
audit.corrected: All four rewritten to their own titles.
